notes.title: Thank You All For Your Support
notes.content:
Dear Community,

I want to thank you all for your support and feedback over the years on my earlier game, [b]"Get Out..."[/b]. I know it didn’t meet expectations, and I appreciate your honesty. I've grown a lot since then and have put my effort into creating something special.

To show my gratitude and share my progress, I'm sharing my latest game, [b]"AL QMRAH RESTAURANT"[/b] for free. Dive into this immersive experience set in a historic kitchen of Mecca, with co-op online playing up to 4 players. Your feedback means a lot to me, and I hope you enjoy this new adventure.

Here is a link for the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071300/AL_QMRAH_RESTAURANT/

Thank You All,
